blurb: Pleasure Cove Marina offers a variety of rental boats including pontoons, center console fishing boats, ski boats, and personal watercraft for activities like tubing, tanning, cruising, relaxing, and fishing. The marina operates on Lake Berryessa, a large freshwater lake with over 165 miles of shoreline, popular for year-round recreation and fishing. Guests can enjoy water sports and family outings with boats equipped with amenities such as stereos, coolers, bimini tops, and life jackets include
